sources.entry: eqMac2 - System-Wide Equalizer for the Mac.

summary.one_liner: eqMac is a macOS system-wide audio equalizer and processing app that routes all system sound through a loopback driver for EQ, volume boosting and related effects.
summary.what_it_does: The README lists features for the eqMac app, which processes system audio for the whole Mac. Free features include system audio processing, a volume booster, HDMI volume support, volume balance for all devices, a basic EQ with bass/mids/treble controls, and an advanced fixed 10-band EQ. Pro-tier features listed include an unlimited-band expert EQ, a spectrum analyzer, AudioUnit hosting, spatial audio, and a per-application volume mixer. AutoEQ headphone correction is available in both tiers. The architecture has a native backend, a remotely hosted Angular UI, and a user-space audio loopback driver based on Apple's Null Audio Server Driver example. The README notes that this repository only contains code for v1.3.2 without Pro features; newer releases are on a private fork.
use_cases: Boosting volume beyond normal levels on a Mac
Headphone frequency response correction with AutoEQ
Balancing volume across devices including HDMI displays
Adjusting per-app volume levels on macOS
notable: Audio loopback driver runs in user space rather than kernel space, unlike older drivers such as SoundFlower
Web-based UI hosted remotely to allow over-the-air updates
Free tier includes system audio EQ, volume booster and HDMI volume support
Roadmap includes a WebSocket API for controlling eqMac from other languages
caveats: This repository contains only v1.3.2 code without Pro features; newer releases are on a private fork
Many headline features (expert EQ, spectrum analyzer, AU hosting, spatial audio, volume mixer) are Pro-only and not in this code
Several roadmap items are not yet implemented
